name: Greater Control
body:
Prerequisites: Swarmborn, swarmborn dispersion racial trait.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves to prevent dispersion. When reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you can be healed without needing a spell like summon swarm to be cast on you first.
